verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships an official CLI (Wally) that documentation says runs models locally offline, and one command points a tool at a model and starts it. However, the evidence never explicitly describes an interactive chat session in the terminal; the terminal flow appears to work by launching a tool such as opencode against the model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an interactive terminal chat command (multi-turn REPL), detail on chat-session features, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal

citations.quote: When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
One command points a tool at a model and starts it. There is nothing to configure by hand
